title: QueueFailed
description: One paper that left the backlog without a page (one JSON object per line in state/queue-failed.jsonl): its quick explainer failed twice, or an operator gave up on it. queue fail appends these; queue add and queue take skip their ids, so it never comes back.

id.description: Stable paper id: arxiv-<id> or doi-<doi with every character outside a-z 0-9 . _ - replaced by ->, lowercase.

reason.description: Why the paper got no page, in a short plain sentence.

at.description: UTC time the paper was given up on, RFC 3339.
